title: PermaFrost-Attack: Stealth Pretraining Seeding(SPS) for planting Logic Landmines During LLM Training
abstract: arXiv:2604.22117v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Aligned large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial manipulation, and their reliance on web-scale pretraining creates a subtle but consequential attack surface. We study Stealth Pretraining Seeding (SPS), a threat model in which adversaries distribute small amounts of poisoned content across stealth websites, increasing the likelihood that such material is absorbed into future training corpora derived from sources such as Common Crawl. translated_title: PermaFrost攻击：用于在大语言模型训练期间埋设逻辑地雷的隐蔽预训练播种（SPS）
translated_abstract: 对齐的大语言模型（LLM）仍然容易受到对抗性操纵，而其对网络规模预训练的依赖创造了一个微妙但影响深远的攻击面。我们研究了隐蔽预训练播种，这是一种威胁模型，其中攻击者将少量投毒内容分散发布到隐蔽网站上，从而增加此类材料被吸收进未来训练语料库（如源自Common Crawl等来源的语料）的可能性。由于每个单独的恶意载荷都很小、分散且表面上无害，这种攻击在数据集构建或过滤阶段很难被检测到。其结果是一种潜伏式投毒形式，在标准评估下基本不可见，但之后可以通过精确的触发器（如<00TRIGGER00>）被激活。我们将这种攻击称为PermaFrost，以反映其潜伏性和可重新激活的特性。我们通过PermaFrost-Attack——一个用于潜在概念的受控框架——来研究这种攻击。
tldr: 提出PermaFrost攻击这一新型威胁模型：攻击者在隐蔽网站播种少量看似无害的投毒内容，使其被大语言模型预训练过程悄然吸收形成潜伏后门，后续可被特定触发词激活。
en_tdlr: PermaFrost-Attack introduces a Stealth Pretraining Seeding (SPS) threat model in which adversaries distribute tiny, benign-looking poisoned payloads across stealth websites, planting latent logic landmines in LLMs during pretraining that remain invisible to standard evaluation but can later be activated by a precise trigger.
